entries.label_vi: Đầu tư giáo dục → lực lượng lao động có kỹ năng → kinh tế phát triển
entries.claim: A well-funded education system produces the skilled workforce on which a modern economy depends.
entries.because: Employers in engineering, healthcare and finance seek technical knowledge, digital literacy and problem-solving; funding for classrooms and teacher training builds them.
entries.result: Companies recruit more easily, unemployment falls and productivity rises.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề về chi tiêu công, giáo dục nghề, đại học, học phí, kỹ năng.

entries.label_vi: Đầu tư công vào giáo dục → thu hẹp bất bình đẳng, tăng thăng tiến xã hội
entries.claim: Public investment in education narrows social inequality.
entries.because: Where schools are poorly funded, good learning becomes a privilege of the wealthy; state-guaranteed access lets children progress on merit.
entries.result: Social mobility strengthens and long-term dependence on welfare falls.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề học phí, giáo dục miễn phí, ngân sách công, trường tư.

entries.label_vi: Công nghệ / học online → linh hoạt và dễ tiếp cận
entries.claim: Digital technology makes learning considerably more flexible and accessible.
entries.because: Students in remote areas attend live lessons, replay recordings and study around their circumstances; institutions serve larger cohorts without new buildings.
entries.result: Participation widens among working adults, rural residents and people with disabilities.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho mọi đề về online learning, remote learning, podcast, mạng xã hội trong học tập.

entries.label_vi: Công nghệ → cá nhân hoá việc dạy
entries.claim: Technology allows teaching to be adapted to the needs of each learner.
entries.because: A teacher cannot adjust the pace for every pupil, but adaptive software identifies weaknesses and provides targeted practice at once.
entries.result: Struggling students get timely support, faster ones are stretched, and teachers are freed for discussion.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề AI tutor, personalised learning, gia sư, lớp đông.

entries.label_vi: Học online / thiết bị → xao nhãng, thiếu tương tác
entries.claim: Online study carries the risk of distraction and reduced human contact.
entries.because: Devices offer endless temptations such as games and social media; solitary learners miss the encouragement, discipline and immediate feedback of a teacher.
entries.result: Concentration and communication skills may weaken.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng làm nhược điểm / phe phản đối trong đề công nghệ, điện thoại, mạng xã hội.

entries.label_vi: Phụ thuộc công nghệ → khoảng cách số, bất bình đẳng
entries.claim: Reliance on online learning may deepen existing inequalities.
entries.because: Families without a reliable connection or suitable device fall behind.
entries.result: A two-tier system in which advantage depends on wealth.
entries.rebuttal: Schools can offer laptop loan schemes and live check-ins.
entries.reuse_vi: Nhược điểm thứ hai của công nghệ; luôn kèm rebuttal để giữ lập trường.

entries.label_vi: Học online rẻ hơn và linh hoạt cho người đi làm
entries.claim: Online study is cheaper and more flexible for learners and institutions.
entries.because: Learners save on commuting, accommodation and printed textbooks; institutions save on buildings and staff.
entries.result: Fees fall and people otherwise excluded, such as rural residents and working parents, gain qualifications.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề học phí / online overpriced / học từ xa.

entries.label_vi: Lớp học truyền thống → tương tác trực tiếp, làm việc nhóm, kỷ luật
entries.claim: Physical classrooms foster teamwork and social skills.
entries.because: Pupils work with peers who hold different viewpoints and share responsibility; a present teacher reads confusion and adjusts instantly.
entries.result: Stronger discipline and cooperation, especially among younger children.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề lớp học vs online, homeschooling, giờ thể dục, hoạt động nhóm.

entries.label_vi: Dạy truyền thông → học sinh phân biệt thông tin thật / giả
entries.claim: Media studies teaches pupils to distinguish reliable information from misleading content.
entries.because: Social media spreads rumour faster than corrections; pupils who check sources and recognise bias are harder to deceive.
entries.result: Better-informed citizens and voters.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề dạy tư duy phản biện, fake news, mạng xã hội, môn công dân.

entries.label_vi: Dạy truyền thông → kỹ năng nghề nghiệp, người tiêu dùng thông thái

entries.result: Employable skills and more informed consumer choices.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thêm môn học thực hành / nghề / công nghệ vào chương trình.

entries.label_vi: Dạy tư duy phản biện → hiểu sâu thay vì học vẹt, hữu ích ở đại học và công việc
entries.claim: Teaching critical thinking encourages pupils to understand ideas instead of merely memorising facts.
entries.because: When learners question, compare and justify their views, they grasp concepts more thoroughly and retain them for longer.
entries.result: Independent reasoning is invaluable at university and at work, where problems rarely come with a ready-made answer.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề dạy tư duy phản biện, thi cử vs dự án, tranh luận, nghệ thuật, khoa học.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn: lồng ghép vào các môn sẵn có thay vì thêm môn riêng
entries.claim: The skill is best developed within existing lessons such as science, history and literature.
entries.because: A separate subject would overload the timetable.
entries.result: Pupils practise it daily without losing core teaching time.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho mọi đề 'nên dạy X ở trường không' (tài chính, đạo đức, công dân…).

entries.label_vi: Ngân sách hạn hẹp: các lĩnh vực khác cũng cấp bách (y tế, giao thông, nhà ở)
entries.claim: Governments have limited funds and many equally urgent responsibilities.
entries.because: Hospitals, transport, housing and social care all need substantial investment, and failures there can cost lives and damage the economy immediately.
entries.result: Spending more on one sector may leave a more pressing need unmet.
entries.reuse_vi: Phe 'ưu tiên lĩnh vực khác' trong mọi đề chi tiêu công (nghệ thuật, thể thao, thư viện, nghiên cứu…).

entries.label_vi: Lập trình → tư duy giải quyết vấn đề từng bước, kiên nhẫn
entries.claim: Coding cultivates computational thinking.
entries.because: Pupils must spell out every instruction and trace their own logic to find why a program fails, which builds patience, attention to detail and cause-and-effect reasoning.
entries.result: Skills transfer to mathematics, science and everyday decisions, and learners see mistakes as normal.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng riêng cho đề dạy lập trình / STEM / máy tính.

entries.label_vi: Lập trình → chuẩn bị cho thị trường việc làm do phần mềm chi phối
entries.claim: Coding prepares children for a world in which software underpins almost every industry.
entries.because: Finance, healthcare, design and farming rely on programs that analyse data and automate routine tasks, so employees who understand them have an advantage.
entries.result: Even pupils who never become engineers can use, question and adapt technology at work.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề công nghệ, STEM, tự động hoá, kỹ năng số, AI.

entries.label_vi: Bài tập về nhà → mất thời gian nghỉ, chơi, gia đình; mệt mỏi
entries.claim: Setting homework robs children of rest, play and family time.
entries.because: After six hours in class, many pupils face two or three more hours of written work, so sleep is cut short and hobbies abandoned.
entries.result: Tired pupils absorb less the next day, which defeats the purpose; resentment turns learning into a chore.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề bài tập về nhà, tuần học ngắn hơn, áp lực học tập, giờ ngủ, thể thao.

entries.label_vi: Học hết ở lớp → công bằng hơn giữa các gia đình
entries.claim: Restricting learning to school hours would make education fairer.
entries.because: At home, children from crowded households or with parents who cannot help are at a disadvantage against classmates with a quiet desk and a private tutor.
entries.result: Everyone has the same conditions, and teachers see what each pupil can do unaided.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề bài tập về nhà, gia sư, trường tư, thi cử.

entries.label_vi: Phản bác: 'bài tập về nhà dạy kỷ luật' → kỷ luật cũng rèn được qua tự học có giám sát
entries.claim: Some argue that homework teaches self-discipline, but this skill can equally be developed through supervised independent study at school.
entries.because: Independent work during school hours also demands self-management.
entries.result: The benefit is kept without the costs.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu phản bác cho đề cấm bài tập.

entries.label_vi: Giáo dục → đổi mới, lập doanh nghiệp, công nghệ mới → việc làm và đầu tư
entries.claim: Educated citizens are more likely to start companies and develop new technologies.
entries.because: Advanced knowledge and training make research and entrepreneurship possible.
entries.result: New jobs and investment, and a wider tax base.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề đại học, nghiên cứu khoa học, STEM, đầu tư công vào giáo dục.

entries.label_vi: Giáo dục → khoẻ mạnh hơn, ít tội phạm → tiết kiệm ngân sách công
entries.claim: Education reduces costs that would otherwise drain public budgets.
entries.because: Educated individuals make healthier choices and are less prone to crime, and better-informed citizens plan their finances and rely less on welfare.
entries.result: A lighter burden on hospitals, police and prisons, freeing public money for investment.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho mọi đề 'lợi ích xã hội của giáo dục' và ngân sách công.

entries.label_vi: Du học → ngoại ngữ, thích nghi, tầm nhìn quốc tế, mạng lưới nghề nghiệp
entries.claim: Studying abroad broadens horizons and improves employability.
entries.because: Daily immersion accelerates language fluency; students learn to adapt, work with diverse people and solve problems alone, which multinational employers value; contacts become networks.
entries.result: A wider range of careers, including positions in several countries.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề du học, trao đổi văn hoá, học ngoại ngữ, song ngữ, đa văn hoá.

entries.label_vi: Du học → gánh nặng tài chính và cảm xúc (nhớ nhà, cô lập)
entries.claim: Studying overseas places a heavy burden on individuals, both financially and emotionally.
entries.because: Tuition, accommodation and living costs consume savings, while homesickness leaves some students isolated.
entries.result: Those who cannot cope may return with debts and disappointing results.
entries.rebuttal: Scholarships, part-time work permits, counselling and careful budgeting reduce the risk.
entries.reuse_vi: Nhược điểm cho đề du học, học phí đại học, nợ sinh viên.

entries.label_vi: Thi cử đo hẹp: trí nhớ và tốc độ, bỏ qua sáng tạo và kỹ năng thực hành
entries.claim: Relying on examinations gives only a narrow picture of ability.
entries.because: Written tests mainly reward memory and speed, while creativity, teamwork and practical skills go unmeasured.
entries.result: Talented people are mislabelled as weak and teaching drifts towards test preparation.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thi cử, bài kiểm tra chuẩn hoá, đánh giá liên tục, dạy theo dự án.

entries.label_vi: Thi cử → áp lực làm sai lệch kết quả; gia sư tạo bất công
entries.claim: Exam results are distorted by pressure and unequal preparation.
entries.because: High-stakes tests cause anxiety that lowers the performance of capable candidates, and families that can afford private tutors give their children an advantage.
entries.result: Results reflect stress and wealth as much as ability.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thi cử, bài tập về nhà, gia sư, áp lực học tập.

entries.label_vi: Giáo dục sớm → nền móng cho mọi việc học (não phát triển nhanh, thói quen học)
entries.claim: The early years lay the foundations for all later learning.
entries.because: Young children's brains develop extremely quickly; play and stories build language, curiosity and concentration.
entries.result: Children enter primary school ready to learn instead of struggling to catch up.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề giáo dục mầm non, trẻ nhỏ, đọc sách, chăm sóc trẻ, trợ cấp nhà trẻ.

entries.label_vi: Giáo dục sớm → hiệu quả nhất để thu hẹp khoảng cách giàu nghèo, rẻ hơn phụ đạo
entries.claim: High-quality early education is the most efficient way to close the gap between rich and poor.
entries.because: Disadvantaged children start school behind in vocabulary and social skills and the gap widens each year.
entries.result: Affordable nurseries give an equal start and cost less than remedial programmes.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề chi tiêu công cho trẻ em, nhà trẻ, bất bình đẳng.

entries.label_vi: Thư viện → tiếp cận thông tin miễn phí cho mọi người (sách, máy tính, internet, nguồn tin cậy)
entries.claim: Libraries give everyone access to information regardless of income.
entries.because: Books, e-books and databases are free, public computers serve residents without internet at home, and librarians help find reliable sources.
entries.result: Job seekers, low-income students and older people are not excluded from the digital world.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thư viện, bảo tàng, nguồn tài nguyên số, khoảng cách số.

entries.label_vi: Thư viện → trung tâm cộng đồng (không gian học, hoạt động trẻ em, lớp ngoại ngữ, CLB sách)
entries.claim: Libraries function as community hubs that bring people together.
entries.because: They provide quiet study spaces, story sessions, language classes and workshops, nurturing a reading habit and social bonds across generations.
entries.result: Isolated residents gain company and libraries stay relevant by adapting (digital lending, flexible hours).
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thư viện, bảo tàng, trung tâm cộng đồng, nghệ thuật công cộng, lễ hội.

entries.label_vi: Bằng đại học vẫn là cánh cửa vào nhiều nghề và thu nhập cao hơn
entries.claim: A degree remains the gateway to many professions.
entries.because: Doctors, engineers and teachers need recognised qualifications, and employers use degrees to screen hundreds of applicants; graduates generally earn more and face lower unemployment.
entries.result: The financial benefit usually outweighs the cost in the long term.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề giá trị của đại học, học phí, học nghề vs đại học, học bổng.

entries.label_vi: Đại học dạy kỹ năng chuyển giao được và tạo mạng lưới quan hệ
entries.claim: University teaches skills that go beyond a particular subject.
entries.because: Students learn to research independently, analyse evidence, meet deadlines and communicate clearly, and they form professional networks.
entries.result: These abilities stay useful when technology changes the content of jobs.
entries.rebuttal: Entrepreneurs who dropped out and skilled trades are exceptions rather than the rule.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề đại học, nghiên cứu, học thuật vs nghề.

entries.because: Low-income families cannot afford books; funded libraries, mobile libraries and free book-gifting schemes put books where there are few.
entries.result: Children who read widely generally achieve better results across subjects, so the investment pays back.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề khuyến khích đọc sách, thư viện, tài nguyên học tập cho vùng nghèo.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: biến đọc sách thành niềm vui (giờ đọc, tự chọn sách, hình mẫu, cha mẹ cùng đọc)
entries.claim: Authorities should help children to enjoy reading rather than treat it as a chore.
entries.because: Daily reading time with free choice of books, author visits, reading challenges, celebrity role models and parental involvement make reading attractive.
entries.result: Enjoyment, not obligation, creates lasting habits.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho mọi đề 'khuyến khích hành vi lâu dài' ở trẻ em (đọc, vận động, ăn uống lành mạnh).

entries.label_vi: Bảo tàng → học bằng vật thật, tương tác, làm môn trừu tượng trở nên hữu hình
entries.claim: Museums make abstract subjects tangible.
entries.because: Handling replicas, watching demonstrations and examining genuine artefacts engages several senses; interactive exhibits encourage questions and independent conclusions; guides adapt explanations to different ages.
entries.result: Pupils understand and remember history and science far better than from textbooks alone.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề bảo tàng, chuyến đi thực tế, thí nghiệm, học thực hành.

entries.label_vi: Bảo tàng → hiểu văn hoá khác, học suốt đời, tiếp cận mọi lứa tuổi
entries.claim: Museums promote cultural understanding and lifelong learning.
entries.because: Collections from different regions and periods let visitors appreciate other traditions; many are free or cheap and offer online resources.
entries.result: Less prejudice, more respect between communities, and learning for adults after school.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề bảo tàng, di sản, lễ hội, trao đổi văn hoá, đa dạng văn hoá.

entries.label_vi: Công nghệ trong lớp → bài học sinh động, hiểu khái niệm khó, phản hồi tức thì
entries.claim: Digital tools make lessons more engaging and help pupils to grasp difficult concepts.
entries.because: Simulations, animations and 3D models show what diagrams cannot; interactive quizzes give instant feedback and keep reluctant learners motivated.
entries.result: Involved students concentrate longer and remember more.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề công nghệ trong lớp học, game giáo dục, mô phỏng, podcast.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn: công nghệ chỉ là công cụ; cần đào tạo giáo viên và mục tiêu rõ
entries.claim: Technology is only a tool; without teacher training and clear goals it may become an expensive distraction.
entries.because: Benefits depend on how it is used.
entries.result: Purposeful use is what improves learning.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho mọi đề 'công nghệ cải thiện học tập'.

entries.label_vi: Học nhạc → rèn tập trung, trí nhớ, kỷ luật, sự kiên trì (lan sang các môn khác)
entries.claim: Learning an instrument trains the mind.
entries.because: Reading notation, memorising pieces and coordinating hands, eyes and ears demand sustained concentration; regular practice teaches patient, repeated effort.
entries.result: Focus and self-discipline carry over into other subjects, and children approach homework with more persistence.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nghệ thuật / âm nhạc / thể thao giúp học tập, môn tự chọn.

entries.label_vi: Âm nhạc → tự tin, hợp tác, bày tỏ cảm xúc, giải toả căng thẳng
entries.claim: Music contributes to emotional wellbeing and teamwork.
entries.because: Playing in a band or choir requires listening, adjusting one's part and sharing responsibility; performing builds confidence; music offers a healthy outlet for feelings.
entries.result: Cooperation, mutual respect and confidence grow.
entries.rebuttal: Instruments cost money, but schools can begin with singing and percussion.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nghệ thuật, thể thao đồng đội, hoạt động ngoại khoá, sức khoẻ tinh thần.

entries.label_vi: Học nhiều ngôn ngữ → cơ hội nghề nghiệp, trí nhớ và chú ý, hiểu văn hoá gốc
entries.claim: Studying several languages broadens career prospects and intellectual abilities.
entries.because: Multilingual graduates can work in international companies and apply abroad; switching languages exercises memory and attention; learners access literature and culture in the original.
entries.result: A clear advantage in a competitive labour market and greater open-mindedness.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề song ngữ, đa ngôn ngữ, ngoại ngữ ở tiểu học, du học.

entries.label_vi: Học nhiều ngôn ngữ → tốn thời gian, dễ nhầm lẫn, quá tải thời khoá biểu
entries.claim: Mastering several languages demands a great deal of time and effort.
entries.because: Hours of vocabulary and grammar reduce time for other subjects, and similar languages cause confusion; extra classes risk overloading the timetable.
entries.result: Workload and stress.
entries.rebuttal: Starting at primary level spreads the load over many years; apps and online partners make practice flexible.
entries.reuse_vi: Nhược điểm cho đề thêm môn học mới / ngoại ngữ / lập trình.

entries.text: Schemes such as Bookstart in the United Kingdom, for instance, give free books to families with young children to encourage reading from an early age.
entries.caution_vi: Bookstart do Book Trust (Anh) điều hành; nêu chung chung, không số liệu.

entries.text: A boy who dislikes novels, for example, may become an enthusiastic reader once offered a book about his favourite football team.

entries.text: A class studying ancient Egypt, for example, will remember the daily lives of ordinary people far more vividly after seeing real tools, jewellery and mummies than after a lesson based on text.
entries.caution_vi: Ví dụ giả định, an toàn.

entries.text: A retired visitor attending a weekend lecture on local history, for instance, may gain as much from the museum as any schoolchild.
entries.caution_vi: Ví dụ giả định, an toàn.

entries.text: A geography class that explores a volcano through a three-dimensional model, for instance, gains a clearer picture than one that relies solely on a textbook photograph.
entries.caution_vi: Ví dụ giả định, an toàn.

entries.text: A pupil who has spent months mastering a difficult piece, for example, learns that perseverance eventually produces results.
entries.caution_vi: Ví dụ giả định, an toàn.

entries.text: A shy pupil who gains confidence by performing in a school concert is likely to speak up more readily in other lessons.
entries.caution_vi: Ví dụ giả định, an toàn.

entries.text: For example, a student who speaks Spanish and French can read news and literature from dozens of countries without relying on translations.
entries.caution_vi: Ví dụ giả định, an toàn.

entries.label_vi: Đánh giá liên tục → theo dõi tiến bộ, phản hồi kịp thời, thưởng cho học đều thay vì nhồi nhét
entries.claim: Continuous assessment tracks progress over time and rewards steady work instead of last-minute cramming.
entries.because: Coursework, projects and regular quizzes show what a student can do in different situations, and teachers can give feedback while there is still time to improve.
entries.result: Assessment becomes part of learning rather than its conclusion.
entries.rebuttal: Coursework needs moderation rules because of plagiarism, teacher workload and inconsistent marking; a short final test can verify the work.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thay thi bằng đánh giá liên tục, dạy theo dự án, giảm áp lực thi.

entries.label_vi: Bài thi chuẩn hoá → thước đo khách quan, so sánh công bằng, tạo động lực ôn tập
entries.claim: Standardised testing provides a clear and objective measure of achievement.
entries.because: Every candidate faces the same questions and marking criteria, so teachers, parents and employers can compare performance across schools; the prospect of a test motivates systematic revision.
entries.result: Standards stay consistent and weak schools can be identified and supported.
entries.reuse_vi: Phe ủng hộ thi cử / bài kiểm tra chuẩn hoá.

entries.label_vi: Một bài thi = ảnh chụp một ngày; nội dung/ngôn ngữ thiên vị một số nhóm
entries.claim: A single test offers only a snapshot of performance on one day and does not give equal conditions to all candidates.
entries.because: Illness or nerves lower the score of capable students; unfamiliar contexts and language disadvantage some communities; families with money buy preparation.
entries.result: A procedure that looks neutral can reinforce existing inequalities.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề 'bài thi có công bằng không', thi đại học, kiểm tra chuẩn hoá.

entries.label_vi: Học theo dự án → vận dụng kiến thức, làm việc nhóm, nhớ lâu, động lực
entries.claim: Project-based learning develops understanding and practical skills.
entries.because: Pupils investigate a real question, apply knowledge, plan their time and cooperate, and they retain ideas longer than facts memorised for a test.
entries.result: Reluctant learners who find exams stressful stay motivated.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề dạy theo dự án, thực hành, STEM, giảm áp lực thi cử.

entries.label_vi: Bài tập nhiều hơn ≠ học nhiều hơn: lợi ích giảm dần, bài lặp vô nghĩa
entries.claim: More homework does not necessarily mean more learning.
entries.because: Beyond a modest amount, repetitive worksheets and copied answers consume time without deepening understanding, especially for younger pupils.
entries.result: Diminishing returns and pupils who see learning as a chore.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề bài tập về nhà, hiệu quả học tập, tuần học ngắn.

entries.label_vi: Tuần học ngắn → nghỉ ngơi, sở thích, gia đình; giáo viên bớt kiệt sức
entries.claim: A shorter school week gives students time to recover physically and mentally.
entries.because: An extra free day allows sleep, hobbies, exercise and family time, and teachers gain preparation time and are less likely to suffer burnout.
entries.result: Lower stress, better mood and better teaching.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề tuần học 4 ngày, wellbeing, giờ học muộn hơn.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn: phụ huynh đi làm khó trông con, học sinh khó khăn mất giờ học
entries.claim: The benefits depend on careful planning.
entries.because: Working parents may struggle to arrange childcare and disadvantaged pupils may lose structured learning time.
entries.result: Schools should offer optional supervised activities.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho đề thay đổi lịch học.

entries.label_vi: Đồng phục → che khác biệt giàu nghèo, giảm trêu chọc, tiết kiệm cho gia đình
entries.claim: A common uniform masks differences in income that would otherwise be obvious.
entries.because: Pupils from low-income homes avoid embarrassment about secondhand clothes, and parents no longer face constant demands for fashionable brands.
entries.result: Children are judged on behaviour and effort rather than labels, and bullying over clothes falls.
entries.rebuttal: Uniforms are limited: they can be costly and do not remove deeper inequalities in resources and home support, so they should be affordable and subsidised.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề đồng phục, bình đẳng, bắt nạt, chi phí học tập.

entries.label_vi: Đồng phục → bớt xao nhãng, cảm giác thuộc về, trách nhiệm
entries.claim: Uniforms remove sources of distraction and foster a sense of belonging and responsibility.
entries.because: Pupils compete less over fashion, staff spend less time on dress codes, and pupils who represent their school behave more carefully in public.
entries.result: Habits of punctuality, neatness and respect carry over into later life.
entries.rebuttal: Uniforms alone cannot create discipline; clear expectations and good relationships matter more.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề kỷ luật, quy định trường học, an toàn.

entries.text: A pupil who struggles with fractions in October, for example, can be helped immediately instead of discovering the problem in a final paper the following summer.
A national examination, for instance, lets a university compare applicants from different regions on equal terms.
A talented pupil who studies in a crowded home and learns English as a second language, for example, may be unable to show her true level.
A group that builds a working model bridge, for example, learns physics far more vividly than a class that only reads about it.
A child who spends two hours copying definitions every evening, for example, rarely gains more understanding than one who completes a single well-designed task.
A teenager who uses a free Friday for sport and volunteering, for instance, returns to school on Monday refreshed.
A school in which pupils arrive in expensive trainers and designer jackets, for example, often has to deal with comparisons, teasing and even theft.

entries.use_vi: Khung cho đề 'How far do you think X will change/remain … in the next 20 years?'

entries.label_vi: Mạng xã hội → học nhóm, chia sẻ tài liệu, hỏi chuyên gia, nền tảng quen thuộc
entries.claim: Social media makes collaboration and access to resources easier.
entries.because: Students create study groups, share notes, ask questions outside class and follow experts; teachers post explanations that pupils watch at their own pace on familiar platforms.
entries.result: Learners engage more readily and communication feels quick and informal.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề mạng xã hội, học nhóm, podcast, video giáo dục.

entries.label_vi: Học từ xa còn phổ biến vì đã đầu tư nền tảng, người học quý sự linh hoạt, trường tiết kiệm chi phí
entries.claim: Schools, universities and families have invested in the platforms, devices and skills needed for online study.
entries.because: Learners value attending from anywhere and studying around work, and institutions save on buildings and staff.
entries.result: Online options will be kept to reach more learners at lower cost.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề học từ xa sau đại dịch, hybrid, làm việc từ xa.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn: trẻ nhỏ cần lớp học; môn thực hành cần phòng thí nghiệm; thiếu internet
entries.claim: The extent of remote learning will be limited.
entries.because: Young children need supervision and social contact, practical subjects need laboratories, and families without reliable internet cannot benefit equally.
entries.result: Remote learning will supplement face-to-face teaching rather than dominate it.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho đề học online / từ xa.

entries.label_vi: Chứng chỉ ngắn → nhanh, rẻ, đúng kỹ năng, phù hợp người đi làm, ghép dần thành bằng
entries.claim: Micro-credentials fit a labour market in which skills change rapidly.
entries.because: A short course is quicker and cheaper than a degree, employers can see exactly what it certifies, and learners can stack courses from different institutions.
entries.result: Higher education becomes more flexible and universities compete on quality and relevance.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề chứng chỉ ngắn hạn, học suốt đời, học online, người đi làm.

entries.label_vi: Công nghệ đổi nhanh → phải cập nhật kỹ năng suốt sự nghiệp
entries.claim: Rapid technological change means that few people can rely on a single set of skills for an entire career.
entries.because: Workers must update their knowledge regularly to stay employable.
entries.result: Continuous learning becomes a necessity rather than a choice.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề học suốt đời, giáo dục người lớn, chứng chỉ ngắn, đào tạo nghề.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn: nghề được quản lý vẫn cần bằng đầy đủ; bằng cấp cho nền tảng rộng
entries.claim: Regulated professions will still require full degrees, and a degree gives broad analytical training that short courses may not.
entries.because: Employers also need to trust the quality of each credential.
entries.result: Micro-credentials supplement degrees rather than replace them.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho đề chứng chỉ ngắn, đào tạo nghề, học online.

entries.label_vi: Podcast → học mọi lúc mọi nơi, tạm dừng / nghe lại, hỗ trợ người khiếm thị, rẻ hoặc miễn phí
entries.claim: Podcasts allow people to learn at times and in places where reading or watching is impossible.
entries.because: Learners can listen while commuting, exercising or doing housework, and can pause, replay and change speed.
entries.result: Otherwise wasted time becomes study time, and listeners with visual impairments or auditory learning styles are included.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề podcast, audiobook, học ngoại ngữ, học khi di chuyển.

entries.label_vi: Podcast → câu chuyện, phỏng vấn, giọng chuyên gia làm môn học sinh động; luyện nghe tự nhiên
entries.claim: A good podcast engages listeners through stories, interviews and expert voices.
entries.because: Hearing a historian or scientist makes a subject feel alive, and language learners get regular exposure to natural speech and vocabulary.
entries.result: Deeper interest and better listening skills.
entries.rebuttal: Listening is passive, so podcasts should be combined with exercises, discussion or feedback.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề phương tiện truyền thông trong giáo dục, tài liệu nghe nhìn, ngoại ngữ.

entries.label_vi: Giáo viên không thể thay bằng công nghệ: động viên, nhận ra cảm xúc, hình mẫu
entries.claim: Good teaching depends on human relationships.
entries.because: A teacher notices when a pupil is confused, anxious or struggling at home, adjusts instantly, encourages at the right moment and acts as a role model.
entries.result: Motivation and confidence that software cannot reproduce.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thay giáo viên bằng máy / AI, học online, gia sư.

entries.label_vi: Gia sư AI → chú ý từng người, trợ giúp mọi giờ, giải thích nhiều cách
entries.claim: AI tutors can give every learner individual attention that classrooms cannot.
entries.because: A system identifies weaknesses, explains a concept in several ways and gives targeted practice at any hour, so learners do not wait for the next lesson.
entries.result: Faster progress and less frustration.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề AI trong giáo dục, gia sư, cá nhân hoá.

entries.label_vi: Gia sư AI → rẻ hơn, đến cả vùng xa; giáo viên rảnh tay để hỗ trợ cảm xúc và sáng tạo
entries.claim: AI tutors will make good tutoring far cheaper and more widely available.
entries.because: Private tuition is expensive and favours wealthy families, whereas AI can reach remote villages and overcrowded schools at low cost.
entries.result: Teachers, freed from basic explanations and marking, focus on discussion, creativity and emotional support.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề AI, gia sư, bất bình đẳng giáo dục, lớp quá đông.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn của AI: trả lời sai, quyền riêng tư, phụ thuộc → cần giáo viên giám sát
entries.claim: AI systems sometimes produce incorrect answers, raise privacy concerns and may encourage dependence.
entries.because: Learners may stop thinking independently.
entries.result: Human oversight remains necessary.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho mọi đề về AI trong giáo dục.

entries.label_vi: Dạy nghề ở trường → vào việc làm ổn định, đáp ứng thiếu hụt nhân lực, hiểu mình hợp nghề gì
entries.claim: Vocational training prepares pupils for the working world.
entries.because: Employers in construction, healthcare, engineering and hospitality report shortages of practically skilled workers, and pupils with such skills move into stable jobs more easily.
entries.result: Lower youth unemployment and earlier discovery of suitable careers.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề giáo dục nghề, học nghề, học việc, thất nghiệp thanh niên.

entries.label_vi: Môn thực hành giữ chân học sinh không hợp học thuật; rèn nhóm, quản lý thời gian
entries.claim: Practical subjects keep engaged the pupils who find purely academic lessons discouraging.
entries.because: Students who struggle with written exams often thrive when they can build, repair or cook something tangible.
entries.result: Confidence is restored and the risk of dropping out falls.
entries.rebuttal: They must not replace literacy and numeracy, and pupils should not be directed towards trades too early.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nghệ thuật, thể thao, dạy nghề, giảm bỏ học.

entries.label_vi: Giáo dục tài chính → tránh nợ xấu và bị lừa (thẻ tín dụng, vay online, lãi suất)
entries.claim: Understanding money helps people to avoid debt and exploitation.
entries.because: Credit cards, student loans and online lending make borrowing easy, but interest, fees and long-term consequences are hard to understand.
entries.result: Pupils who learn how interest works and compare offers are less likely to be misled or overwhelmed by debt.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề môn tài chính, quản lý tiền, nợ sinh viên.

entries.label_vi: Học lập ngân sách / tiết kiệm sớm → an toàn tài chính khi trưởng thành, ít phụ thuộc phúc lợi
entries.claim: Early lessons in budgeting and saving shape lifelong habits.
entries.because: Children who plan a monthly budget, set savings goals and tell needs from wants build financial security as adults.
entries.result: Less stress and dependence on welfare, and support for goals such as buying a home or starting a business.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề kỹ năng sống, môn mới trong trường, hướng nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: Dạy đạo đức → biết lập luận về đúng sai thay vì chỉ theo luật
entries.claim: Ethics lessons teach children to reason about moral questions instead of merely following rules.
entries.because: Discussing real dilemmas, such as reporting a cheating friend or behaving online, trains pupils to weigh evidence, consider other perspectives and justify decisions.
entries.result: Independent judgement helps them resist peer pressure and tempting shortcuts.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề dạy đạo đức, công dân, tôn giáo, tư duy phản biện.

entries.label_vi: Giáo dục đạo đức → khoan dung, công dân có trách nhiệm; trường bổ sung cho gia đình
entries.claim: Ethics education promotes tolerance and responsible citizenship.
entries.because: Classrooms bring together children of different cultures and beliefs, and structured discussion teaches them to listen to views they do not share.
entries.result: Less prejudice, more cooperation and safer communities.
entries.rebuttal: Families differ and many children receive little guidance at home; schools can offer a neutral setting to complement them.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề công dân, đa văn hoá, tôn giáo, giáo dục giá trị.

entries.label_vi: Dạy phòng chống tội phạm → hiểu hậu quả, chống áp lực bạn bè, rẻ hơn xử lý sau
entries.claim: Teaching young people the consequences of crime helps to prevent it.
entries.because: Lessons on peer pressure, drug misuse, online fraud and cyberbullying give pupils the knowledge to resist risky situations; prevention is cheaper than policing and prisons.
entries.result: Fewer offenders and victims.
entries.rebuttal: Lessons must be age-appropriate and only one part of a wider strategy.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề an toàn, phòng chống tội phạm, an toàn mạng.

entries.label_vi: Giáo dục công dân → tham gia đời sống cộng đồng, bỏ phiếu, tình nguyện
entries.claim: Civic education develops responsible citizens.
entries.because: Pupils who learn how local government works, why voting matters and how to volunteer take part in community life as adults.
entries.result: Safer, more cooperative communities.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề công dân, tình nguyện, hội đồng học sinh.

entries.label_vi: Phục vụ cộng đồng bắt buộc → đồng cảm, trách nhiệm, kỹ năng làm việc nhóm
entries.claim: Compulsory community service develops empathy and a sense of responsibility.
entries.because: Time with elderly residents, homeless people or children with disabilities makes social problems real, and pupils learn teamwork, communication and reliability.
entries.result: Qualities valued by employers and universities.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề tình nguyện, thực tập, nghĩa vụ xã hội.

entries.label_vi: Cộng đồng được lợi từ nhân lực tình nguyện; phản bác 'ép buộc làm mất thiện chí'
entries.claim: Communities benefit from the extra help that compulsory service provides.
entries.because: Charities, hospitals and councils gain willing volunteers and projects such as clean-ups become possible.
entries.result: Many reluctant starters continue voluntarily once they see results; a requirement reaches all students, not only the motivated.
entries.rebuttal: Let pupils choose from a range of projects to limit resentment.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nghĩa vụ, quân dịch, dịch vụ cộng đồng bắt buộc.

entries.label_vi: Học VỀ các tôn giáo → hiểu văn hoá, lịch sử, thời sự; giảm định kiến
entries.claim: Learning about religions builds cultural understanding.
entries.because: Religious ideas shape art, literature, law and politics worldwide, and familiarity with other beliefs weakens stereotypes.
entries.result: Pupils understand history and current events better and respect neighbours' traditions.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề tôn giáo, đa văn hoá, môn lịch sử.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn: dạy trung lập, không truyền đạo; tôn trọng quyền của gia đình
entries.claim: Religious education has legitimate limits.
entries.because: Beliefs are private and parents differ; a lesson that promotes one faith may clash with family wishes and amount to indoctrination.
entries.result: Teach about beliefs factually and neutrally, alongside non-religious worldviews, and let families opt out of devotional activities.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho đề tôn giáo, đạo đức, giá trị.

entries.label_vi: Học sinh tham gia quản trị trường → trách nhiệm, kỹ năng dân chủ, quyết định thực tế hơn
entries.claim: Taking part in decision-making teaches responsibility and democratic skills.
entries.because: Pupils on school councils learn to listen, negotiate compromises and own the results, and they understand budgets and priorities; their insight improves decisions.
entries.result: A stronger sense of belonging and more respect for rules they helped to shape.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề hội đồng học sinh, dân chủ trong trường, lãnh đạo học sinh.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn: an toàn, nhân sự, chương trình cốt lõi vẫn do người lớn quyết
entries.claim: Student involvement must have limits.
entries.because: Safeguarding, staff appointments and the core curriculum need professional expertise and legal responsibility.
entries.result: Student voice works best as consultation on appropriate issues, with adults keeping the final say.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho đề trao quyền cho học sinh.

entries.label_vi: Quảng bá đa dạng văn hoá → giảm định kiến, kỹ năng thực tế cho thế giới toàn cầu
entries.claim: Promoting diversity broadens pupils' horizons and weakens prejudice.
entries.because: Celebrating different languages, festivals and histories teaches children to appreciate other traditions, a practical skill for working with colleagues from many countries.
entries.result: Differences seem interesting instead of threatening.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề đa văn hoá, trao đổi văn hoá, ngoại ngữ, di cư.

entries.label_vi: Công nhận đa dạng → học sinh thiểu số thấy mình thuộc về, đi học đều, ít bị bắt nạt
entries.claim: Recognising diversity helps minority pupils to feel that they belong.
entries.because: Children who see their language, religion and history respected are more confident and engaged, whereas those who feel invisible may withdraw or face bullying.
entries.result: Better attendance, results and cooperation across groups.
entries.rebuttal: Promotion should not be tokenistic; it must appear in materials, staff training and everyday practice, and stress shared values.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề đa dạng, hoà nhập, chống bắt nạt.

entries.text: A teenager who learns basic electrical installation at school, for example, may qualify for an apprenticeship at sixteen instead of drifting between short-term jobs.
A graduate who understands compound interest, for example, will think carefully before relying on a credit card to cover everyday expenses.
A student who has debated the fairness of sharing exam answers, for example, may be better prepared to resist the temptation to cheat.
A teenager who has learned how online scams work, for example, is far less likely to become a victim or an accomplice.
A teenager who helps to run a weekly food bank, for example, learns how much effort is needed to support people in need.
A class that studies how festivals such as Diwali, Ramadan and Christmas are celebrated, for example, learns respect for neighbours' traditions.
A student representative who helps to design a recycling scheme, for example, learns to present a proposal, gather support and manage a small project.
A school that invites parents to share cooking and stories from their home countries, for example, helps pupils to see differences as interesting instead of threatening.

entries.label_vi: Nghệ thuật → tư duy sáng tạo: sản phẩm gốc, không có đáp án duy nhất, thử nghiệm và cải tiến
entries.claim: The arts develop creative thinking by requiring pupils to produce original work.
entries.because: Designing, composing or painting has no single correct answer, so learners generate ideas, test them, accept criticism and improve.
entries.result: Flexible thinking and confidence in one's own ideas, which innovation depends on.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nghệ thuật, sáng tạo, thiết kế, môn tự chọn.

entries.label_vi: Nghệ thuật → giải quyết vấn đề: cân nhắc nguyên liệu, kiên trì sau thất bại; nhà tuyển dụng cần ý tưởng mới
entries.claim: Arts education strengthens problem solving.
entries.because: Artists analyse materials, balance competing demands and persevere through failed attempts, habits needed in engineering, science and business.
entries.result: Employers value people who propose fresh approaches.
entries.rebuttal: Creativity is not exclusive to the arts, and lessons that copy models encourage no originality; the benefit depends on real freedom to experiment.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nghệ thuật, STEM, đổi mới.

entries.label_vi: Nghệ thuật → bày tỏ cảm xúc, giảm căng thẳng, tự hào về sản phẩm; bắt buộc để không bỏ lỡ tài năng
entries.claim: Art contributes to emotional wellbeing and confidence.
entries.because: Creating something gives young people a healthy way to express feelings and relieve stress, and displaying work builds pride.
entries.result: If art were optional, pupils who believe they are not artistic would never try it and some talents would stay undiscovered.
entries.rebuttal: Art uses time and materials, but short sessions and inexpensive resources keep the cost modest.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề môn nghệ thuật bắt buộc / tự chọn, sức khoẻ tinh thần.

entries.label_vi: Học nghệ thuật → quan sát, tập trung, kiên nhẫn, trí nhớ và tư duy không gian lan sang môn khác
entries.claim: Arts subjects train skills that support academic study.
entries.because: Drawing, acting and music demand careful observation, sustained concentration and patient, repeated effort; research has associated them with stronger memory and spatial reasoning.
entries.result: Pupils approach hard mathematics and science problems with more determination.
entries.rebuttal: Evidence is not entirely clear: motivated pupils may choose the arts, and the arts cannot replace direct teaching of literacy and numeracy.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nghệ thuật giúp học tập, âm nhạc, thể thao.

entries.label_vi: Nghệ thuật giữ học sinh gắn bó với trường: thành công ở thứ hữu hình → tự tin, đi học đều, ít bỏ học
entries.claim: The arts keep many pupils engaged with school.
entries.because: Students who find written exams discouraging thrive when they can perform, design or create something tangible.
entries.result: Confidence, attendance and effort in other lessons improve.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nghệ thuật, thể thao, môn thực hành, giảm bỏ học.

entries.label_vi: Thể thao → sức khoẻ thể chất (béo phì, ít vận động), thói quen sống chủ động
entries.claim: Sport contributes to physical health, which is increasingly urgent.
entries.because: Many children spend hours sitting at screens and obesity is rising; regular sport builds fitness and habits that last for life.
entries.result: Long-term health problems and pressure on health services are reduced.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thể thao học đường, giáo dục thể chất, béo phì trẻ em.

entries.label_vi: Thi đấu → biết thắng và thua, nỗ lực, kiên trì, tự chủ; cải thiện nhờ luyện tập
entries.claim: Competition teaches pupils how to handle both success and failure.
entries.because: Playing to win encourages effort and perseverance, while losing teaches children to accept disappointment and try again; training shows that improvement comes from patient, repeated effort.
entries.result: Resilience that serves them in exams and careers.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thi đấu, thể thao đồng đội, thi cử cạnh tranh.

entries.label_vi: Thi đấu đồng đội → hợp tác, trách nhiệm chung, tự hào tập thể
entries.claim: Team competition fosters cooperation and a sense of belonging.
entries.because: Players listen to others, accept roles and take shared responsibility; supporting the school team builds pride.
entries.result: Community spirit and motivation to keep fit.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thể thao đồng đội, hoạt động ngoại khoá, nghệ thuật nhóm.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn: thi đấu phải hoà nhập, không loại trẻ yếu; nhấn mạnh nỗ lực và fair play
entries.claim: Competition should be handled carefully.
entries.because: If only the strongest pupils play, weaker children lose confidence, and excessive pressure to win can cause conflict or injury.
entries.result: Offer teams at different levels, emphasise effort and fair play, and provide non-competitive activities.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho đề thi đấu / cạnh tranh trong trường.

entries.label_vi: Thể dục → giảm căng thẳng, cải thiện tâm trạng và tập trung, kỹ năng xã hội, tự tin
entries.claim: PE supports mental wellbeing, social skills and concentration.
entries.because: Exercise relieves stress and improves mood, pupils who move regularly concentrate better later, and team games teach cooperation and fair play.
entries.result: Self-confidence grows, especially for pupils who struggle academically.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề giáo dục thể chất, wellbeing, tư vấn học đường.

entries.label_vi: Khám phá đam mê → động lực học nội tại, kiên trì, định hướng nghề nghiệp
entries.claim: Discovering a passion motivates pupils to learn.
entries.because: Students who love programming, music or biology study longer and persevere without being pushed, and passion guides choices about future study and careers.
entries.result: Young people who have explored their interests are more likely to find satisfying work.
entries.rebuttal: Exams cannot be abandoned: qualifications are needed and provide a fair standard, so aim for balance.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề mục đích của trường học, câu lạc bộ, thi cử vs sở thích.

entries.label_vi: Học ngoại ngữ sớm → phát âm tự nhiên, nhiều năm học hơn, đạt trình độ cao hơn
entries.claim: Young children absorb sounds and structures easily.
entries.because: Before adolescence they learn through listening, songs and games, developing accurate pronunciation and an instinctive feel for grammar; starting early also gives many more years of study.
entries.result: A higher level of proficiency by the time they leave school.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề ngoại ngữ ở tiểu học, song ngữ, giáo dục sớm.

entries.text: A group designing costumes for a school play, for example, must find solutions within a limited budget and time.
A pupil who has repeatedly redesigned a clay model until it stands securely, for example, practises exactly the persistence that engineers need.
A pupil who sees a painting displayed in the school corridor, for instance, may gain a confidence that spreads to other lessons.
A child who plays football three times a week, for example, is more likely to stay active as an adult.
entries.caution_vi: Ví dụ giả định, dùng 'more likely'.

entries.text: A team that loses a match, for example, may learn to analyse its mistakes and train more effectively before the next game.
A pupil who joins a robotics club and discovers a talent for engineering, for instance, may choose a university course that suits her.
A child who sings songs in French every week, for example, may pronounce the language more naturally than a teenager who begins at fourteen.
A child who learns to enjoy swimming or running at school, for example, is more likely to remain active as an adult.

entries.label_vi: Đại học → nghiên cứu, đổi mới, đào tạo bác sĩ / kỹ sư / giáo viên; cử nhân đóng thuế nhiều hơn
entries.claim: Higher education drives research and innovation.
entries.because: Universities train the doctors, engineers, teachers and scientists society depends on, and their research creates new industries; graduates tend to earn and pay more tax.
entries.result: Public investment returns revenue to the state, and analytical skills stay useful as technology changes jobs.
entries.reuse_vi: Phe 'ưu tiên đại học / nghiên cứu' trong đề chi tiêu công.

entries.label_vi: Học phí cao → học sinh nghèo không dám nộp đơn, chọn trường rẻ, mất nhân tài
entries.claim: High tuition fees place a heavy financial burden on students and their families.
entries.because: Fees, accommodation and living costs can consume a family's savings; capable young people from modest backgrounds fear debt and may not apply or choose cheaper courses regardless of talent.
entries.result: Ability alone does not decide who studies, and society loses potential.
entries.rebuttal: Grants, scholarships and income-contingent loans repaid only when graduates earn above a threshold can protect access.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề học phí, đại học miễn phí, nợ sinh viên, du học.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn của đại học miễn phí: người đóng thuế chịu chi phí, người giàu cũng hưởng, bất bình đẳng bắt đầu từ sớm hơn
entries.claim: The effect of free tuition on equality has limits.
entries.because: Taxpayers must fund it and some benefit goes to wealthier students; inequality begins in early education and family support.
entries.result: Free tuition must be combined with help for living costs and investment in early schooling.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho đề đại học miễn phí / trợ cấp học tập.

entries.label_vi: Cảnh sát → an ninh là nền tảng của đời sống; răn đe, phản ứng khẩn cấp nhanh
entries.claim: Public safety is the foundation of everyday life.
entries.because: Residents who feel secure work, invest and send children to school; visible policing deters offences and shortens emergency response times.
entries.result: Safer neighbourhoods encourage business and keep communities together.
entries.reuse_vi: Phe 'ưu tiên cảnh sát / an ninh' trong đề chi tiêu công.

entries.label_vi: Trách nhiệm cá nhân / gia đình: tự chủ học tập, lựa chọn đào tạo, nhà nước can thiệp quá nhiều xâm phạm việc gia đình
entries.claim: Learning depends first on personal effort.
entries.because: Pupils who take ownership and parents who encourage good habits achieve more; adults value the training they choose and invest in; extensive state involvement can intrude on family matters.
entries.result: Motivation and accountability are stronger.
entries.reuse_vi: Phe 'cá nhân tự chịu trách nhiệm' trong đề cá nhân vs nhà nước.

entries.label_vi: Nhà nước chịu trách nhiệm chính: giáo dục là hàng hoá công, tiêu chuẩn chung, quy mô lớn, xã hội được lợi
entries.claim: Education is a public good that markets and families cannot provide equally.
entries.because: Without public funding, good learning is a privilege of the wealthy; the state sets common standards, trains teachers and builds schools at a scale individuals cannot match.
entries.result: A skilled, informed population benefits society as a whole.
entries.reuse_vi: Phe 'nhà nước chịu trách nhiệm' trong đề giáo dục công.

entries.label_vi: Tài nguyên số → phục vụ nhiều người hơn với chi phí thấp, 24/7, cập nhật tức thì
entries.claim: Digital resources reach far more people at a lower cost per user.
entries.because: One online database or e-book collection serves thousands at once, at any hour and from any location, and can be updated instantly and searched in seconds.
entries.result: Rural residents, people with disabilities and working adults benefit most; printed stock needs space and replacement.
entries.reuse_vi: Phe 'tài nguyên số / online' trong đề so sánh với thư viện, giáo trình, lớp học.

entries.claim: Science education drives economic progress and solves practical problems.
entries.because: Employers in engineering, healthcare and technology seek technical knowledge, and research creates new industries; citizens who understand science can judge evidence on climate change and public health.
entries.result: Growth, innovation and better public decisions.
entries.reuse_vi: Phe 'ưu tiên khoa học / STEM' trong đề chi tiêu công.

entries.label_vi: Học việc: vừa làm vừa học, có lương, không nợ, có kinh nghiệm và quan hệ với nhà tuyển dụng
entries.claim: Apprenticeships combine paid work with training.
entries.because: Apprentices spend years in a real workplace, build a record of reliable performance and receive a wage with usually no tuition fees; employers who trained them often offer a permanent post.
entries.result: A smooth move from education to work and earlier financial independence than graduates with debt.
entries.rebuttal: The advantage is not universal: some professions need degrees and narrow training can leave workers vulnerable, so programmes should include transferable skills.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề học việc, giáo dục nghề, so sánh với đại học, thất nghiệp thanh niên.

entries.label_vi: Học việc phá vòng luẩn quẩn 'cần kinh nghiệm mới có việc'; đào tạo khớp nhu cầu doanh nghiệp
entries.claim: Apprenticeships solve the problem of inexperience and match training to real needs.
entries.because: Employers want experience that young people cannot gain without a job; apprenticeships give paid work with training, and companies help design programmes, so skills match the labour market and shortages are filled.
entries.result: Youth unemployment falls, employers gain loyal trained staff and the state pays less welfare and gains more tax.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thất nghiệp thanh niên, thực tập, giáo dục nghề.

entries.label_vi: Học suốt đời → tự tin, kết bạn, trí não hoạt động, cơ hội lần hai cho người bỏ học sớm
entries.claim: Lifelong learning improves wellbeing and social inclusion.
entries.because: Adults who return to education gain confidence, make friends and keep their minds active, reducing isolation; it offers a second chance to those who left school early.
entries.result: Narrower gap between rich and poor, benefits passed to children, and a lighter burden on healthcare.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề giáo dục người lớn, người cao tuổi, giáo dục cộng đồng.

entries.label_vi: Giáo dục an toàn → cứu mạng, giảm thương tích (qua đường, bơi, cứu hoả, sơ cứu)
entries.claim: Safety education saves lives and prevents injuries.
entries.because: Children who learn road safety, swimming, fire hazards and first aid protect themselves and others, and the skills last for life.
entries.result: Fewer preventable injuries and fewer families struck by tragedy.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề an toàn, y tế công cộng, giáo dục sức khoẻ.

entries.label_vi: Diễn tập khẩn cấp → cộng đồng bình tĩnh, kiên cường; phòng rẻ hơn chữa; kiến thức lan về gia đình
entries.claim: Safety education builds resilient and responsible communities.
entries.because: Emergency drills teach calm responses to earthquakes, floods or fires, children share knowledge at home, and preparing in advance is cheaper than dealing with disasters later.
entries.result: Less damage, a lighter burden on emergency services and public money saved.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thiên tai, an toàn mạng, giáo dục công dân.

entries.label_vi: Trao đổi văn hoá → độc lập, tự tin, hiểu văn hoá khác, rõ mục tiêu
entries.claim: Exchange programmes promote personal growth and cultural understanding.
entries.because: Living with host families or studying with classmates from other countries teaches appreciation of other traditions; being away from home builds independence, confidence and resilience.
entries.result: Less prejudice, more respect between communities and a clearer sense of goals.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề trao đổi sinh viên, du học, đa văn hoá.

entries.label_vi: Gia sư → chú ý từng em, lấp lỗ hổng kiến thức, tự tin, kỹ thuật ôn thi
entries.claim: Tutors give each learner individual attention.
entries.because: A tutor identifies weaknesses and gives targeted practice at once, explains topics in several ways without classmates watching, and teaches revision and exam skills.
entries.result: Gaps are closed before they grow, hesitant pupils gain confidence and anxiety falls.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề gia sư, học thêm, lớp đông, thi cử.

entries.label_vi: Giới hạn: gia sư đắt → bất công; phụ thuộc → cần chương trình dạy kèm miễn phí
entries.claim: Private tuition has drawbacks.
entries.because: It is expensive, so wealthy families enjoy an advantage, and heavy reliance may leave pupils dependent.
entries.result: Free tutoring schemes and after-school support can reduce the inequality.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu giới hạn cho đề gia sư / học thêm.

entries.label_vi: Tư vấn học đường → hỗ trợ tâm lý sớm: nhận dấu hiệu, không gian trò chuyện bảo mật, chuyển chuyên gia
entries.claim: Counsellors provide early support for emotional and mental health.
entries.because: Exam pressure, social media and family problems cause anxiety and burnout; a trained counsellor notices warning signs, offers a confidential space and refers serious cases.
entries.result: Fewer students drop out or suffer long-term harm.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề sức khoẻ tinh thần học sinh, áp lực thi cử, bắt nạt.

entries.label_vi: Tư vấn học đường → hướng nghiệp, chọn môn, quản lý thời gian, hoà giải bắt nạt; giáo viên rảnh tay
entries.claim: Counsellors give practical guidance on study, careers and relationships.
entries.because: They help pupils choose subjects and plan for university or work, mediate conflicts and support victims of bullying.
entries.result: A safer atmosphere where students concentrate on learning, and teachers focus on teaching.
entries.rebuttal: Counsellors cost money and may be overstretched, but prevention is cheaper than dealing with crises.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề hướng nghiệp, bắt nạt, hỗ trợ học sinh.

entries.text: A school leaver who completes a three-year apprenticeship in a hospital kitchen, for example, may be offered a permanent position at the end of it.
A factory worker whose job is automated, for example, can retrain as a technician and remain in work instead of relying on benefits.

A teenager who is anxious about exams, for example, can learn coping strategies instead of struggling alone.

entries.label_vi: Học tại nhà → cá nhân hoá tốc độ, lịch linh hoạt theo sở thích, tránh bắt nạt
entries.claim: Homeschooling allows teaching to be tailored to the needs of each child.
entries.because: A parent working with one or two children can identify weaknesses and give targeted practice at once, and the timetable can follow the child's interests.
entries.result: Faster progress in strong areas and fewer problems such as bullying.
entries.reuse_vi: Ưu điểm cho đề học tại nhà, giáo dục cá nhân hoá, trường tư.

entries.label_vi: Học tại nhà → thiếu giao tiếp xã hội: không biết hợp tác, xử lý xung đột, tiếp xúc quan điểm khác
entries.claim: Learning mostly at home limits children's social development.
entries.because: School is where children make friends, resolve disagreements and work in groups, and meet peers from different backgrounds; at home they may spend most days with adults and siblings.
entries.result: Confidence and teamwork may suffer later in life; clubs and online classes help but need time and organisation.
entries.reuse_vi: Nhược điểm cho đề học tại nhà, học online hoàn toàn.

entries.label_vi: Học tại nhà → thiếu chuyên môn và cơ sở vật chất (phòng thí nghiệm, sân thể thao)
entries.claim: Homeschooling cannot match the expertise and facilities that schools provide.
entries.because: Few parents can teach every subject to a high standard, and laboratories, sports grounds and specialist equipment are rarely available at home.
entries.result: Pupils may leave with gaps in their knowledge that are difficult to repair.
entries.reuse_vi: Nhược điểm cho đề học tại nhà, học online, trường quá nhỏ.

entries.label_vi: Dạy đa ngôn ngữ → giáo viên: soạn tài liệu nhiều ngôn ngữ, cần bằng ngoại ngữ cao, lớp trình độ lẫn lộn, thiếu người đủ chuẩn
entries.claim: Multilingual education places considerable demands on teachers.
entries.because: Staff must prepare materials in several languages, hold advanced language qualifications and adapt lessons for pupils at very different levels; qualified bilingual teachers are scarce.
entries.result: Heavy workloads and weaker lessons unless training, assistants and shared materials are provided.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề song ngữ / đa ngôn ngữ, giáo viên thiếu và quá tải.

entries.label_vi: Đánh giá wellbeing → học tốt hơn, phát hiện sớm vấn đề; cả trường cải thiện chính sách; nhưng phải kín đáo
entries.claim: Wellbeing and learning are closely linked.
entries.because: Anxious, lonely or exhausted pupils concentrate less and fall behind; short surveys and conversations help schools identify problems early.
entries.result: Early help and policies on homework, bullying and pastoral support improve.
entries.rebuttal: Formal mood tests could stigmatise pupils, so use anonymous surveys, observation and counsellors, and keep data confidential.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề wellbeing học sinh, tư vấn học đường, áp lực học tập.

entries.label_vi: Điện thoại trong lớp → mất tập trung (được thiết kế để cạnh tranh sự chú ý); cấm là cách đơn giản bảo vệ giờ học
entries.claim: Allowing phones in lessons undermines concentration.
entries.because: Notifications, games and social media tempt pupils to glance at their screens, and even a brief interruption breaks the train of thought needed to follow an explanation.
entries.result: Teachers report smoother lessons and more participation when phones are out of sight.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề cấm điện thoại, mạng xã hội, thiết bị trong lớp.

entries.label_vi: Điện thoại → gian lận, quay lén, bắt nạt mạng; cấm là quy tắc đơn giản, dễ thực thi
entries.claim: Unrestricted phone use exposes students to misuse, from cheating to cyberbullying.
entries.because: Phones make it easy to cheat, record classmates without consent or circulate hurtful messages, and teachers cannot monitor every screen.
entries.result: A clear ban removes these temptations.
entries.rebuttal: Phones are useful and parents need contact, but schools can provide computers, allow phones in designated sessions and route emergencies through the office.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề cấm điện thoại, an toàn mạng, kỷ luật.

entries.text: A child who is passionate about astronomy, for example, can spend extra weeks exploring the subject instead of moving on after a single lesson.
A child taught entirely at home, for instance, may find a first job interview or group project unusually daunting.
A parent with no scientific background, for example, may struggle to guide a teenager through chemistry experiments.
A science teacher required to deliver chemistry in a second language, for example, must first master the specialist vocabulary herself.

Intro (The issue of {problem} is a growing concern + sẽ phân tích nguyên nhân và đề xuất giải pháp) → Body 1 (2 nguyên nhân: mỗi nguyên nhân = nêu nguyên nhân → cơ chế → hệ quả → ví dụ) → Body 2 (2 giải pháp: To address this issue… / In addition…) → Conclusion (stems mainly from… but … offer a realistic way forward)
entries.use_vi: Khung cho đề 'What are the causes of…? What solutions can be proposed?'

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân: hoàn cảnh kinh tế xã hội khó khăn (thiếu chỗ học, dinh dưỡng, hỗ trợ của cha mẹ)
entries.claim: Social and economic disadvantage lies behind the problem in many communities.
entries.because: Children from low-income households often lack a quiet place to study, adequate nutrition or parental support, as parents may work long hours or several jobs.
entries.result: Attainment is held back from an early age and gaps widen without outside help.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề kết quả học kém, nợ sinh viên, bỏ học, bất bình đẳng.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân: trường thiếu kinh phí → thiếu giáo viên đủ chuẩn, cơ sở vật chất xuống cấp, giáo viên giỏi chuyển đi
entries.claim: Chronic underfunding is a major contributor to the problem.
entries.because: When budgets are tight, schools cannot recruit qualified staff, maintain buildings or buy up-to-date materials; experienced teachers move to better-off districts.
entries.result: The strain on existing resources makes the situation steadily worse.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thiếu giáo viên, lớp quá đông, kết quả học kém.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân: khối lượng việc nặng, lương thấp, địa vị nghề nghiệp giảm → giáo viên bỏ nghề / kiệt sức
entries.claim: Heavy workloads combined with modest pay are a significant source of the problem.
entries.because: Long hours, endless paperwork and relatively low salaries leave teachers undervalued and exhausted; graduates who can earn more elsewhere see little reason to enter teaching.
entries.result: Many leave or never join, and remaining staff have even more to handle.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề thiếu giáo viên, giáo viên kiệt sức.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân căng thẳng đại học: áp lực học tập, hạn chót, cạnh tranh điểm + lo tiền và sống xa nhà
entries.claim: Intense academic pressure and financial worries are leading causes of student stress.
entries.because: Heavy workloads, frequent deadlines and competition for grades leave little time for rest; fees, living costs and part-time work add burden, and living away from home can feel isolating.
entries.result: Strain accumulates over months and affects health and performance.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề áp lực sinh viên, sức khoẻ tinh thần, bỏ học đại học.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân nợ sinh viên: học phí và chi phí sống tăng; gia đình không hỗ trợ; việc làm lương thấp sau tốt nghiệp
entries.claim: Financial barriers play a substantial part in student debt.
entries.because: Rising tuition and living costs and the loss of income while studying push people into heavy borrowing, particularly students whose parents cannot help.
entries.result: Graduates in low-paid or insecure work struggle to repay.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề nợ sinh viên, học phí, tiếp cận đại học.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân lớp quá đông: dân số tăng nhanh, di cư vào đô thị nhanh hơn việc xây trường
entries.claim: Rapid population growth and urban migration contribute to overcrowded classrooms.
entries.because: When families move to cities faster than new schools are built, existing classrooms must absorb additional children.
entries.result: Class sizes rise well beyond a manageable level.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề lớp quá đông, đô thị hoá, nhà ở.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân người lớn ít đi học: chi phí, thiếu thời gian, không thấy lợi ích rõ, tự ti
entries.claim: Cost, lack of time and low awareness keep adults out of education.
entries.because: Fees and lost income discourage many; where people see little connection between study and rewards, or are held back by busy schedules, they do not engage.
entries.result: Working adults with family commitments are the typical non-participants.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề giáo dục người lớn, học suốt đời, đào tạo lại.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: tăng kinh phí có mục tiêu (xây lớp, tuyển giáo viên, thiết bị) + ưu đãi giữ giáo viên giỏi ở vùng khó
entries.claim: Governments should commit more funding where it is needed most.
entries.because: Extra money can be channelled into recruiting teachers, constructing classrooms and modernising equipment, and incentives attract and keep experienced staff in deprived areas.
entries.result: Investment pays for itself through a better-educated and more productive workforce.
entries.reuse_vi: Giải pháp cho đề thiếu giáo viên, lớp đông, kết quả học kém.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: hệ thống hỗ trợ (tư vấn, cố vấn, giới hạn khối lượng công việc, bữa sáng miễn phí, câu lạc bộ học sau giờ)
entries.claim: Stronger support systems would reduce the strain on learners and staff.
entries.because: Counselling, mentoring and reasonable workload limits identify problems early; breakfast schemes and after-school study clubs provide what some homes lack.
entries.result: Prevention is far cheaper than dealing with the consequences later.
entries.reuse_vi: Giải pháp cho đề kiệt sức, áp lực, học sinh vùng khó.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: lương cao hơn, học bổng, lộ trình nghề nghiệp, đào tạo liên tục
entries.claim: Authorities should offer attractive incentives.
entries.because: Higher salaries, scholarships and structured career pathways encourage talented individuals to enter and remain in teaching, and ongoing training keeps them confident.
entries.result: A stable, motivated workforce raises standards for everyone.
entries.reuse_vi: Giải pháp cho đề thiếu giáo viên, STEM, kiệt sức.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: học phí hỗ trợ, trợ cấp sinh hoạt, vay trả theo thu nhập, khoá tối / online, học nghề vừa làm vừa học
entries.claim: Provision should be made more flexible and affordable.
entries.because: Grants, scholarships, subsidised accommodation, loans repaid only above an income threshold and evening or online courses let people study without sacrificing income.
entries.result: Barriers fall and participation rises among groups previously excluded.
entries.reuse_vi: Giải pháp cho đề nợ sinh viên, giáo dục người lớn, căng thẳng tài chính.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: chiến dịch truyền thông, hình mẫu, cố vấn, tiếp xúc sớm (câu lạc bộ, dự án thực hành), đào tạo giáo viên chống định kiến
entries.claim: Awareness campaigns and visible role models would change attitudes.

entries.text: A student from a low-income family, for example, may finish a degree owing the equivalent of several years' salary.
A talented engineering graduate, for example, may earn far more in industry than in a classroom.
A teacher who marks papers every evening and weekend, for example, has almost no time to rest, so exhaustion accumulates.
A first-year student who works evenings to pay rent, for example, may have little energy left to study.
A city school built for six hundred pupils that now enrols nine hundred, for example, must squeeze three children into spaces designed for two.
A single parent who works two jobs, for example, has neither the money nor the energy for evening classes.
A girl who builds a simple robot at primary school, for example, is more likely to see engineering as a future option.
